status: planning sensitivity; noncontractual, uncontracted and not underwritten
purpose: Current financing proposal for investor review; the full facility case is a stress test and does not prescribe the first draw.

current_model.draw_window_months: 1–24 from closing; maturity does not reset
current_model.rate_type: fixed nominal annual rate on drawn balance only

illustrations.note: Hypothetical closing draw only; not a recommended first draw.
Full-utilization stress case only; staged draws would produce lower early payments.

protections: Each draw requires written approval and an itemized quote-backed scope.
Interest is charged only on principal actually drawn; unused capacity has no interest.
The 24-month interest-only period runs from closing and cannot restart on later draws.
No automatic interest capitalization, balloon, equity, royalty or permanent ownership transfer is included.
Quarterly reporting, milestone evidence and a protected operating reserve are required.
disclosure: This file is a planning proposal, not a lender quote, commitment, appraisal or repayment guarantee. Final documents require lender and counsel review.
